description: This Java source file defines a class named Mqtt3Validator that extends AbstractMqttValidator to specify validation logic for MQTT 3.1.1 connections within a messaging system. It includes methods for validating connection parameters such as URI schemes, client counts, addresses, and header mappings, ensuring configuration compliance with MQTT 3.1.1 protocol constraints.

classes.name: Mqtt3Validator
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractMqttValidator to implement validation logic specific to MQTT 3.1.1 protocol. It enforces constraints such as client count and header mapping support, and provides a factory method for instantiation.
